label.procurement-empty: No orders for this pickup day.
label.pickup-day-unknown: There is no pickup day on this date.
label.closing-clear: Every order was collected and paid for.

description.packing-hint: Tap each item once you have packed it.
description.confirm-cancel: Order {{code}} by {{name}} will be cancelled. This cannot be undone.
description.confirm-delete-passkey: You will no longer be able to sign in with this device.
description.scan: Hold the customer's QR code in front of the camera. Without a camera, type the pickup code instead.
description.closing-open: These orders are prepared but neither collected nor paid for. Call the customers before closing up.
description.procurement-open: Orders open until {{date}}. Until then, orders can still come in or drop out.
description.procurement-review: Review window until {{date}}. Admins can still cancel orders, then the list goes to the bakery.
description.procurement-dispatched_one: Sent to the bakery at {{date}}. This list is binding ({{count}} order).
description.procurement-dispatched_other: Sent to the bakery at {{date}}. This list is binding ({{count}} orders).
description.confirm-cancel-dispatched: Order {{code}} by {{name}} will be cancelled. The order was already sent to the bakery and stays as it is.
description.procurement-no-bakery-address: Not sent: no bakery address. As soon as an admin sets one, the order goes out; until then, please order from the bakery by hand.

error.passkey-failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
error.camera: The camera could not be opened. Type the pickup code instead.
